```{r}
library(lme4)

tt <- lmer(
  kg_ha ~ SB +
    (1 + SB | gen) +
    (1|trial/blk), data = data222)



re <- ranef(tt)$gen

damage_coef <- data.frame(
  gen = rownames(re),
  intercept = fixef(tt)[1] + re[, "(Intercept)"],
  damage_coef = fixef(tt)["SB"] + re[, "SB"]
)



fix <- fixef(tt)
re  <- ranef(tt)$gen

dc_gen <- data.frame(
  gen = rownames(re),
  B0  = fix["(Intercept)"] + re[, "(Intercept)"],
  B1  = fix["SB"]          + re[, "SB"]
)

dc_gen$DC <- (dc_gen$B1 / dc_gen$B0)*100
```

```{r}
      shape = attainable,

    size = 2.2

  # Texto da média alinhado ao seu respectivo intervalo (lado a lado)

    data = simu_summary,
    aes(
      x     = pressure,
      y     = ci_high,  # posiciona o rótulo próximo à ponta superior do IC
      # Opção 1 (base R):

      # Opção 2 (scales): label = number(mean_loss, accuracy = 0.01),
      color = pressure,
      group = attainable
    ),
```

```{r}




# --- Libraries ---------------------------------------------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

# --- Data prep ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Expect columns: loss (numeric), pressure (factor with 2 levels)
df <- ylmer_simu_min %>%
  mutate(pressure = factor(pressure))

# Validate
stopifnot(all(c("loss", "pressure") %in% names(df)))
if (nlevels(df$pressure) != 2) {
  stop("This script expects exactly two pressure levels; found: ",
       paste(levels(df$pressure), collapse = ", "))
}

# Set the level names you want to treat as "low" vs "high"
lvl_low  <- "Low pressure"
lvl_high <- "High pressure"
if (!all(c(lvl_low, lvl_high) %in% levels(df$pressure))) {
  stop("Level names not found in df$pressure. Levels are: ",
       paste(levels(df$pressure), collapse = ", "))
}

# Manual colors for legend
pressure_cols <- c(
  `High pressure`  = "#6F3F1F", # brown
  `Low pressure` = "#2E8B57"  # green #7FBF7B #6F3F1F
)

# --- Helper: safe bandwidth (avoids approx/bw errors) ------------------------
safe_bw <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) >= 2) {
    # Try standard rule; fallback if it fails
    bw <- tryCatch(stats::bw.nrd0(x), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    if (is.na(bw) || bw <= 0) {
      # Fallback: heuristic based on range
      rng <- diff(range(x))
      bw <- max(rng / 50, .Machine$double.eps)
    }
  } else {
    # If <2 values, choose tiny positive bw so density is effectively flat
    bw <- 1e-6
  }
  bw
}

# --- Mixture-dominance segmentation ------------------------------------------
# Prevalence weights
p_low  <- mean(df$pressure == lvl_low)
p_high <- mean(df$pressure == lvl_high)

# Bandwidth (shared for all densities to keep them comparable)
bw_all <- safe_bw(df$loss)

# Overall density on full data
d_all <- density(df$loss, bw = bw_all, na.rm = TRUE)
dd    <- tibble(x = d_all$x, y_all = d_all$y)

# Group vectors
loss_low  <- df$loss[df$pressure == lvl_low]
loss_high <- df$loss[df$pressure == lvl_high]

# Group densities on the same grid; if group has <2 points, make it ~0
d_low  <- if (sum(is.finite(loss_low))  >= 2) {
  density(loss_low,  bw = bw_all, from = min(dd$x), to = max(dd$x), n = length(dd$x))
} else {
  list(x = dd$x, y = rep(0, length(dd$x)))
}
d_high <- if (sum(is.finite(loss_high)) >= 2) {
  density(loss_high, bw = bw_all, from = min(dd$x), to = max(dd$x), n = length(dd$x))
} else {
  list(x = dd$x, y = rep(0, length(dd$x)))
}

# Dominance at each x (which group contributes more to the mixture)
dd <- dd %>%
  mutate(
    mix_low  = p_low  * d_low$y,
    mix_high = p_high * d_high$y,
    segment  = if_else(mix_low >= mix_high, lvl_low, lvl_high)
  )

# --- Boundary (where segment flips) ------------------------------------------
# Find indices where segment changes; take first boundary for the dashed line
chg_idx <- which(diff(as.numeric(factor(dd$segment, levels = c(lvl_low, lvl_high)))) != 0)
boundary_df <- if (length(chg_idx) >= 1) {
  tibble(x = dd$x[chg_idx[1] + 1])  # +1: first x in the new segment
} else {
  tibble(x = numeric(0))            # empty -> ggplot draws nothing (no error)
}

# --- Split for plotting -------------------------------------------------------
dd_low  <- dd %>% filter(segment == lvl_low)
dd_high <- dd %>% filter(segment == lvl_high)

# --- Plot --------------------------------------------------------------------
ec_losses = ggplot() +
  # Areas for each segment of the single density (legend via fill mapping)
  geom_area(data = dd_low,
            aes(x, y_all, fill = segment),
            color = NA, alpha = 0.70) +
  geom_area(data = dd_high,
            aes(x, y_all, fill = segment),
            color = NA, alpha = 0.85) + #
  # Single outline keeps the silhouette crisp
  geom_line(data = dd, aes(x, y_all), color = "white", linewidth = 1.5) +
  # Dashed vertical line at the transition (if any)
  geom_vline(data = boundary_df, aes(xintercept = x),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1, size = 2) +
  # Manual legend
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Pressure",
    values = pressure_cols,
    breaks = c(lvl_low, lvl_high)
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
 scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 2500, by = 250))+
  xlim(0,2500)+
  labs(
    x = "Economic losses (USD/ha)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


ec_losses
```

# Economic damage threshold

## Group 1


```{r}
# Function to Simulate EDC
set.seed(123)

simula_LDE <- function(n, media_rp, sd_rp, eficacia, cd_base, custo_range, preco_range) {
  simulacoes <- tibble(
    rendimento_potencial = rnorm(n, media_rp, sd_rp),
    custo_controle = runif(n, custo_range[1], custo_range[2]),
    preco_produto = runif(n, preco_range[1], preco_range[2]),
    eficacia = eficacia
  ) %>% 
    mutate(
      cd_base = cd_base,
      coeficiente_dano = cd_base * rendimento_potencial,
      LDE = (custo_controle / (preco_produto * coeficiente_dano)) * eficacia
    )
  return(simulacoes)
}


n = 50000 # number of simulations
media_rp = 11.14 # in ton/ha
sd_rp = 0.70  # SD of attainable yield
eficacia = rnorm(50000, 0.54, 0.1) #  in proportion
cd_base = 0.02
custo_range = c(40, 160) # cust of control (US$)
preco_range = c(100, 600) # soybean price (US$)

# run the simulation
simula_g1 <- simula_LDE(n, media_rp, sd_rp, eficacia, cd_base, custo_range, preco_range)
```

```{r}
edt_g1 = simula_g1 |> 
  ggplot(aes(rendimento_potencial, eficacia, 
             color = LDE, size = coeficiente_dano))+
  geom_point()+
  #scale_color_viridis_c(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1))+
    scale_colour_stepsn(
    colours = c("#2E8B57",   # dark brown
                "#7FBF7B",   # medium brown
                "#D1BE91",   # beige transition
                "#A6764D",   # light green
                "#6F3F1F"),  # dark green
    n.breaks = 6,             # number of steps (adjust for contrast)
    breaks = seq(0, 8, 1),
    name = "EDT",
    guide = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 6)   
  )
) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
   labs(color = "EDT",
     x = "Attainable yield (ton/ha)",
       y = "Fungicide efficacy (%)",
     size = "DC")+
  theme_bw()+
    theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    text = element_text(size = 14),
```

## Group 2

```{r}
# Function to Simulate EDC
set.seed(123)

simula_LDE <- function(n, media_rp, sd_rp, eficacia, cd_base, custo_range, preco_range) {
  simulacoes <- tibble(
    rendimento_potencial = rnorm(n, media_rp, sd_rp),
    custo_controle = runif(n, custo_range[1], custo_range[2]),
    preco_produto = runif(n, preco_range[1], preco_range[2]),
    eficacia = eficacia
  ) %>% 
    mutate(
      cd_base = cd_base,
      coeficiente_dano = cd_base * rendimento_potencial,
      LDE = (custo_controle / (preco_produto * coeficiente_dano)) * eficacia
    )
  return(simulacoes)
}


n = 50000 # number of simulations
media_rp = 9.9 # in ton/ha
sd_rp = 0.70  # SD of attainable yield
eficacia = rnorm(50000, 0.54, 0.1) #  in proportion
cd_base = 0.02
custo_range = c(40, 160) # cust of control (US$)
preco_range = c(100, 600) # soybean price (US$)

# run the simulation
simula_g2 <- simula_LDE(n, media_rp, sd_rp, eficacia, cd_base, custo_range, preco_range)
```

```{r}
edt_g2 = simula_g2 |> 
  ggplot(aes(rendimento_potencial, eficacia, 
             color = LDE, size = coeficiente_dano))+
  geom_point()+
  #scale_color_viridis_c(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1))+
    scale_colour_stepsn(
    colours = c("#2E8B57",   # dark brown
                "#7FBF7B",   # medium brown
                "#D1BE91",   # beige transition
                "#A6764D",   # light green
                "#6F3F1F"),  # dark green
    n.breaks = 6,             # number of steps (adjust for contrast)
    breaks = seq(0, 8, 1),
    name = "EDT",
    guide = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 6)   
  )
) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
   labs(color = "EDT",
     x = "Attainable yield (ton/ha)",
       y = "Fungicide efficacy (%)",
     size = "DC")+
  theme_bw()+
    theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 20, b = 0, l = 0),  # Aumenta a margem à direita da legenda
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18,face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
simula_g1$group = "Group 1"

simu_all = rbind(simula_g1,simula_g2, simula_g3)
```
```{r}

# GROUP 1

set.seed(123)

DC_g1 <- 0.02
price_rice <- seq(300, 600,length.out = 200)
cost <- seq(40, 160,length.out = 200)
lambda = seq(0.40, 0.80,length.out = 200)

combined_data_g1 <- expand.grid(lambda = lambda, price_rice = price_rice,
                             cost = cost, DC = DC_g1)


EDT_simulated_g1 = combined_data_g1 %>% 
  mutate(EDT = (cost/(price_rice*DC))*lambda)

EDT_simulated_g1$group = "Group 1"
# GROUP 2

DC_g2 <- 0.02

combined_data_g2 <- expand.grid(lambda = lambda, price_rice = price_rice,
                             cost = cost, DC = DC_g2)


EDT_simulated_g2 = combined_data_g2 %>% 
  mutate(EDT = (cost/(price_rice*DC))*lambda)

EDT_simulated_g2$group = "Group 2"

# GROUP 3

DC_g3 <- 0.05

combined_data_g3 <- expand.grid(lambda = lambda, price_rice = price_rice,
                             cost = cost, DC = DC_g3)


EDT_simulated_g3 = combined_data_g3 %>% 
  mutate(EDT = (cost/(price_rice*DC))*lambda)

EDT_simulated_g3$group = "Group 3"

simu_all = rbind(EDT_simulated_g1,EDT_simulated_g2,EDT_simulated_g3)
```

```{r}

heat_EDT_all = simu_all %>%
 # filter(group == "Group 1") %>% 
  filter(EDT <=9) %>% 
  filter(cost <=120) %>% 
  #filter(lambda >= 0.75) %>% 
 # filter(lambda <= 0.76) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(lambda, cost, fill = EDT)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(40, 120, by = 20),
                     expand = c(0.02,0.02)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.40, 0.80, by = 0.10),
                     expand = c(0,0)) +
  #scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(100, 600, by = 100)) +
scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = c("#2E8B57",   # dark brown
                "#7FBF7B",   # medium brown
                "#D1BE91",   # beige transition
                "#A6764D",   # light green
                "#6F3F1F"),  # dark green
    n.breaks = 6,             # number of steps (adjust for contrast)
    breaks = seq(0, 8, 1),
    name = "EDT",
    guide = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 6)   
  )
) +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 1)+

    axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
```
